earnings.title: Regeneron Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial and Operating Results
highlights: Dupixent ® global net sales (recorded by Sanofi) increased 35% to $6.5 billion
EYLEA HD ® U.S. net sales increased 62% to $699 million
Libtayo ® global net sales increased 51% to $550 million
GAAP EPS increased 35% to $18.45; non-GAAP EPS (a) increased 70% to $20.07
Third quarter 2026 revenues increased 36% to $5.1 billion versus third quarter 2025

quotes.text: This was an outstanding quarter for Regeneron, with Dupixent, EYLEA HD, and Libtayo each achieving record net sales.
We are pleased with our third quarter financial results, which marked our third consecutive quarter of double-digit growth in both revenue and non-GAAP EPS.
quotes.by: Christopher Fenimore, Executive Vice President, Finance and Chief Financial Officer of Regeneron

items.heading: We are substantially dependent on the success of EYLEA HD, EYLEA, and Dupixent.
